description: Complex analog oscillator: two oscillators with FM, AM and sync between them, a shaper on the mix, glide, a fade envelope and a modulation router with six slots

params.text: Sets the range of that oscillator's TUNE knob: FINE is a semitone up and down, COARSE is an octave up and down, SEMI is an octave up and down quantized to semitones
Offsets the V/OCT input for that oscillator, over the range set by its tune mode switch
Offsets that oscillator three octaves up and down, and modulating it produces arpeggios
Sets the pulse width of that oscillator's wave, which makes the saw a double saw and changes the asymmetry of the triangle
Picks that oscillator's wave: PULSE, SAW or TRIANG
Sets the balance between oscillator A and oscillator B
Sets how much oscillator A modulates the frequency of oscillator B, which adds harmonics
Sets how much oscillator A modulates the amplitude of oscillator B
Sets how strongly the reset of oscillator A disturbs oscillator B, from interfering with its phase at a low setting to hard sync at the maximum
Sets the decay time of the envelope triggered by the GATE input
Distorts the mixed wave, with its character set by OFFSET
Adds an offset voltage to the wave before the shaper, which makes the distortion asymmetric
Sets the maximum rate at which the pitch follows a change of the V/OCT input
SKIPGATE leaves the glide out when the pitch changes at the same time as the gate, ALWAYS applies the glide to every pitch change
Attenuates and inverts the modulation input of the same number before it reaches the control assigned to that slot
Assigns that modulation slot: press it, then move the control the slot should change
Changes the pitch of both oscillators together, and is left alone by the randomize command

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of both oscillators, 1V per octave
A gate that triggers the fade envelope, and whose timing the SKIPGATE glide mode uses
A signal multiplied by the fade envelope and sent to the fade output
A control voltage for the control assigned to the modulation slot of the same number

outputs.text: The fade envelope, or the signal at the EXT jack multiplied by that envelope

notes: a modulation input does nothing until its slot is assigned: press the slot's button, then move the control the slot should change
